sentences: A European spacecraft called Hera has sent back its first **image** of a pair of small **asteroids** that travel through space together.
Until now, the two rocks looked like one point of light, but in this picture they can be seen **separately** for the first time.
The bigger asteroid, Didymos, is about 780 meters wide, while the smaller one is only about 151 meters **across**.

In 2022, the smaller asteroid was hit **on purpose** by another spacecraft, and the crash, which was a test of how to **protect** Earth from dangerous space rocks, changed the time it takes to circle the bigger one by about thirty-two minutes.
en.answer: Hera라는 유럽 우주선이 함께 우주를 이동하는 작은 소행성 한 쌍의 첫 사진을 보내왔다.

sentences: Im November ist das Wetter in Deutschland oft grau, und an vielen Morgen liegt dichter **Nebel** über den Feldern und Flüssen.
Nebel entsteht, wenn sich feuchte Luft in einer klaren Nacht stark abkühlt und sich daraus winzige **Tropfen** bilden.
Je länger die Nächte im Herbst werden, desto häufiger bildet sich der Nebel, besonders in **Tälern** und an Seen.
Im Straßenverkehr ist Nebel gefährlich, weil man andere Autos und Fußgänger oft erst sehr spät **erkennt**.
de.answer: 11월에 독일의 날씨는 자주 흐리고, 많은 아침에 들판과 강 위로 짙은 안개가 깔립니다.
